title: sqlv_render_sql
description: Render one statement to SQL with ? placeholders and bound parameters. kind selects the source: mapper XML (default), statement annotations, an iBatis 2 sqlMap, or a MyBatis-Plus wrapper chain.

kind.description: Statement source: mapper XML (default), a @Select/@Insert/@Update/@Delete annotation, an iBatis 2 <sqlMap>, or a wrapper chain.

statement_id.description: Statement id for kind=mapper or kind=ibatis: bare (findById) or namespace-qualified (com.example.UserMapper.findById).

xml.description: One mapper XML document (kind=mapper) or one <sqlMap> document (kind=ibatis). Use documents instead when mapper includes cross namespaces.

documents.description: Several mapper documents (path + text) so namespace-qualified includes resolve across files; kind=mapper only.

params.description: Parameter values bound to #{...} and ${...}; a JSON object keyed by mapper variable name, or an array for scalar parameters.

text.description: Java source text for kind=annotation, or the LambdaQueryWrapper/QueryWrapper chain for kind=wrapper.

method.description: kind=annotation: the annotated method to render (findById or Class#findById). Required when the source has more than one annotated statement.

entity.description: kind=wrapper: the entity projection. Without it the wrapper cannot be rendered and the result is unresolved, never a guessed table.

class.description: Entity class name, for diagnostics only.

columns.description: Java field name to column name (userName to user_name). Every field the chain uses must be present.

dialect.description: kind=wrapper: dialect deciding pagination and identifier quoting; mysql when absent.
